header.title: TISS claim forms
header.sub: Sessions marked as "via insurance". Status: draft → submitted → paid/denied. TISS XML 4.01.00 + PDF available for manual submission on each insurer's portal.

lote.title: Generate monthly TISS batch
lote.subHtml: Bundles all draft claim forms for the chosen insurer in the selected month into a single XML ready for submission. TISS requires one batch per insurer.

submit.title: Send batch to insurer
submit.subHtml: Submits directly via the insurer's API. Only available for insurers with an implemented submitter. The A1 .pfx certificate and the password are used locally to sign the XML and never persisted on the server.
submit.certHintHtml: Certificate tied to your CPF/CNPJ, issued by an ICP-Brasil CA. Not stored — used only to sign this batch.
submit.sandbox: Sandbox mode (does not submit to real production)

list.emptyHint: To create one: open a session and check "via insurance" before saving.
list.btnPdfTitle: Open claim form in printable format
